items.exampleEn: It has been abnormally warm this winter.
The shortness of the meeting surprised everyone.
items.exampleZh: 會議這麼短，讓大家都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: The engineer used a micrometer to measure the thin wire.
items.exampleZh: 工程師用測微計量那條細電線。

items.exampleEn: She came in carrying an armful of flowers.
items.exampleZh: 她抱著滿懷的花走進來。

items.exampleEn: The number one hundred is written as a one followed by two noughts.
items.exampleZh: 一百這個數字的寫法是一後面接兩個零。

items.exampleEn: Add one ounce of butter to the pan.
items.exampleZh: 在鍋裡加一盎司的奶油。

items.exampleEn: Could you buy a pint of milk on your way home?
items.exampleZh: 你回家路上可以買一品脫牛奶嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The price of eggs has been abnormally high this month.
items.sentenceZh: 這個月的蛋價異常地高。

items.audioEn: The recipe needs four ounces of sugar and a pint of milk.
items.audioZh: 這份食譜需要四盎司的糖和一品脫的牛奶。
items.questionZh: 這份食譜需要多少牛奶？

items.sentenceEn: He dropped an armful of books on my desk and smiled.
items.sentenceZh: 他把一大疊書往我桌上一放，笑了笑。

items.sentenceEn: Because of the shortness of time, we skipped lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 因為時間很短，我們沒吃午餐。

items.stemEn: Pour half a ____ of milk into the bowl and mix well.
items.stemZh: 把半品脫的牛奶倒進碗裡，攪拌均勻。

items.stemEn: The shop was ____ quiet for a Saturday; only three customers came in.
items.stemZh: 以星期六來說，店裡異常冷清，只來了三位客人。

items.passageEn: My grandmother's old cake recipe came from England, so it uses ounces and pints instead of the units we use today. When I first tried it, the cake was abnormally flat. I checked every step thoroughly and found my mistake: I had used almost a whole pint of milk instead of half. Grandma laughed and said that in her school days, children learned to measure everything carefully. Her teacher even showed them a micrometer for measuring very small things. "If you get a number wrong, your score is nought," the teacher used to say. Since I was only staying a short time, I baked the cake again that same evening. This time it was perfect, and I left with an armful of cakes for my friends.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶的老蛋糕食譜來自英格蘭，所以用的是盎司和品脫，而不是我們現在用的單位。我第一次照著做時，蛋糕異常地扁。我徹底檢查了每個步驟，找到了錯誤：我用了將近一整品脫的牛奶，而不是半品脫。奶奶笑著說，她上學的時候，孩子們都要學著仔細量每樣東西。她的老師甚至給他們看過一種用來量極小東西的測微計。老師常說：「數字錯一個，分數就是零。」因為我這次只待很短的時間，當天晚上就又烤了一次蛋糕。這次很完美，我離開時抱著滿懷的蛋糕要送給朋友。

questions.questionZh: 作者第一次做的蛋糕為什麼很扁？
作者離開時帶走了什麼？
options: 奶奶那份英格蘭的老食譜
老師以前用過的測微計

items.promptZh: 這杯咖啡大約有八盎司。
referenceEn: This cup of coffee is about eight ounces.
There are about eight ounces of coffee in this cup.
rubricZh: ounce 的複數是 ounces（例如 eight ounces）

items.instructionZh: 用 armful 造一個句子，說說你曾經抱著一大堆東西的情況。
referenceEn: I carried an armful of files to the meeting room.
I came back from the market with an armful of vegetables.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 armful，常用 an armful of…（例如 an armful of books）；複數 armfuls 也正確
